title: Goh Choon Phong was awarded shares of Singapore Airlines Ltd

circumstances_desc: MIT has issued 824,584 new units to the Manager on 3 Aug 26 at S$1.9397 per unit as payment of 1) 50% of base fee in relation to 29 data centres in the USA acquired on 22 Jul 21; and 2) 100% of base fee in relation to the data centre in Japan acquired on 28 Sep 23. The issue price is based on the 10-day volume-weighted average traded price of MIT prior to and ended on 30 Jun 26. Following the issuance, the Manager holds 35,292,698 units in MIT and the total number of MIT units in issue is 2,855,828,015.
